Hidden leaks often show up as damp cupboards, swollen skirtings, mould smells, pressure drops or a water meter that keeps moving. H2O Plumbers helps trace likely leak points and explain sensible repair options before damage spreads.

Blocked drains can start with slow sinks, gurgling pipes, bad smells, overflowing gullies or toilets that do not clear properly. The team checks the blockage symptoms and uses the right approach to restore flow.

Core drilling is used when pipework needs a clean, accurate opening through concrete, brick or structural surfaces. H2O Plumbers supports plumbing alterations, bathroom work and drainage routes where careful access matters.

Drain hydro jetting uses high-pressure water to clear stubborn grease, sludge, roots and debris from inside drainage lines. It is useful when repeat blockages suggest the pipe needs more than a basic clearing attempt.

items.item_title: What should I check before calling a plumber in the Garden Route?
How do I know if a hidden leak needs leak detection?
Why does my drain keep blocking after I clear it?
When is drain hydro jetting the better option?
Can H2O Plumbers help homes and businesses?

settings.editor: Before booking, note where the problem starts, how long it has been happening and whether more than one tap, drain or fixture is affected. A plumber Garden Route team can use those details to understand whether it sounds like a leak, blockage, fixture fault or pressure issue.

Leak detection is worth arranging when you notice damp walls, wet cupboards, mould smells, unexplained water use, pressure drops or a meter that moves while taps are closed. Those signs can point to a hidden pipe leak that should be traced before more damage develops.

A drain that keeps blocking may have grease build-up, root entry, pipe damage, poor fall or a deeper obstruction in the line. Repeated chemical clearing can hide the problem for a short time, but it usually does not deal with the cause.

Drain hydro jetting is useful when ordinary drain clearing does not remove the build-up properly. High-pressure water can help clean grease, sludge, debris and some root-related obstruction from the inside of the pipe so flow is restored more thoroughly.

Yes. H2O Plumbers works with residential and commercial clients across the Garden Route, including homes, offices, rental properties, guesthouses and business premises. The team helps with general plumbing, leak detection, blocked drains, core drilling support and drain hydro jetting.
